inputs.commit_message: Complete ASOL production cutover after guard isolation fixes
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/hesham/gova
echo '=== canonical workspace pre-sync ==='
git status --short --untracked-files=no
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
git fetch --prune origin main
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
git pull --ff-only origin main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
echo head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo '=== production cutover ==='
NEXT_PUBLIC_ASOL_CONTROL_URL=https://asol-control.vercel.app NEXT_PUBLIC_ASOL_SUBMAIN_URL=https://asol-submain.vercel.app NEXT_PUBLIC_ASOL_SUB2MAIN_URL=https://asol-sub2main.vercel.app npm run deploy:all
